title: HarnessBank selection-inversion phenomenon support hold
required_unit: paired per-gene harness evolution histories and downstream outcomes under the frozen verification rule, with enough lineage to reconstruct selected-versus-rejected verification decisions
reason: The aggregate train/test result is insufficient to distinguish verification-selection inversion from small-n ranking noise, winner's curse, survivorship, or ordinary adaptive selection. The bound current-source audit has not confirmed a replayable first-party corpus exposing paired gene histories, outcomes, and verification lineage.
reopen_only_if: A first-party release exposes replayable paired gene histories/outcomes and verification lineage sufficient to reconstruct the frozen selected-versus-rejected decision unit without substituting synthetic or inferred histories. A release-surface or primary-source change requests re-audit only and does not automatically clear this hold or authorize scientific progression.
